title: ai3-mvp Repository Configuration
description: Per-repository configuration for the ai3-mvp GitHub App. Place as .github/ai3-mvp.json in your repository.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE support

oneOf.description: Explicitly suppress all actions for this severity. Must be the only element.
One or more actions to execute. Precedence rules: 'block' supersedes 'annotate' (both create a Check Run; block's failure conclusion wins).

actionList.description: Action list for a severity level. Either ["ignore"] alone, or one or more of: block, issue, comment, notify, annotate.

severityActions.description: Map severity levels to action lists. Unspecified severities inherit from org or app defaults.
